Resolves #19266

A child scope now enumerates inherited provider data the way it reads it. `Provider#getTopLevelDataKeys`, the only proxy trap that stopped at the closest provider, now collects keys from every provider on the chain, closest first. It also reads each provider's key version, so an enumeration re-runs when any provider on the chain gains a key. `JSON.stringify`, spread, rest and `Object.keys` of parent-owned data no longer come out empty. The walk mirrors `#findDataOwner`, and no trap changes.

Evidence: L2 (four unit arms, red-first on dev `f1302fb7d5`) + a local cross-repo probe against Institution's pinned engine → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-4). Residual: the Institution receipt, Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#243.

### 🪜 Strategic-Fit Decision

Per §9 Strategic-Fit Step-Back:

- **Rationale**: the one trap that stopped at the closest provider now walks the chain the way `#findDataOwner` does, reading every level's key version on the way, so an enumeration of a hierarchical data proxy sees the object a named read sees and re-runs when any provider on the chain gains a key. ### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #19266 (the measured table on `f1302fb7d5`, the ledger, four ACs), `dev`'s `Provider#getTopLevelDataKeys` (iterates `#dataConfigs` of this provider only, reads its own `#dataKeyVersion`), `#findDataOwner` (the chain walk with per-level version reads), `hasNestedDataStartingWith` (already walks the chain), `createHierarchicalDataProxy`'s `ownKeys` trap (the only caller), and the two Brain sites that document the old behaviour (`ai/services/knowledge-base/SearchService.mjs:249`, `ai/services/memory-core/CoalescingEngineService.mjs:193`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** collect the top-level keys under the path from every provider on the chain, closest first, into one set, reading each visited provider's `#dataKeyVersion` so an effect that enumerated re-runs on a key gained anywhere on the chain; a key declared on two levels appears once and still reads through `get` to the closest owner. It must not touch the `get` / `getOwnPropertyDescriptor` traps or the write path, and the arms must use real providers on parent and child components.
*   **Patch Verdict:** matches. `getTopLevelDataKeys` delegates to `#collectTopLevelDataKeys(prefix, keys)`, which reads `this.#dataKeyVersion`, adds this level's keys, then recurses into `getParent()` (the same cross-instance private call `#findDataOwner` makes). Four arms in `ProviderNestedDataConfigs.spec.mjs` cover the ticket's ACs one to one; against `dev`'s `Provider.mjs` all four fail, at the head `test/playwright/unit/state/` runs 53/53 here, CI 37/37 at `06dd870`.
*   **Premise Coherence:** coheres with verify-before-assert (the ticket's table is a measurement, the arms are red-first) and with the engine's one-source-of-truth for data reads: enumeration and lookup now agree by construction.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge:** enumeration order is now the child's keys followed by the parent's (Set insertion order), where `dev` returned the child's alone. Nothing in the engine reads that order as a contract (`Object.keys(...).sort()` in every arm is the right habit), and `JSON.stringify` of a merged object ordering child keys before inherited ones is a reasonable reading — but it is an observable that changed, so a consumer that serialises provider data for a digest would see a different byte order. Non-blocking; worth one sentence in the JSDoc if it ever bites.

Cross-repo consequence, not this PR's to fix: the Brain's AiConfig nodes are `Neo.state.Provider` chains, and two comments there state that `{...aiConfigNode}` is measurably `{}` because the `ownKeys` trap enumerates local keys only — that sentence becomes false once the Brain's engine pin includes this fix. The rule they defend ("never spread an AiConfig node") still stands for the SSOT reason ADR 0019 §3 gives, so the fix is a rewording, filed on the Brain side as a defect-note.

I also looked for a consumer of `getTopLevelDataKeys` beyond the trap (none in `src/` or `apps/`), for a `#dataKeyVersion` read skipped on a level with no matching keys (none: every visited level reads it before filtering, which is what the fourth arm proves), and for a change to the write path (none) and found no concerns.
